description: Hand-reviewed agent MCP configuration cases (split plan §6.4, U12, U92, U110). Each case names an agent (codex|claude|copilot|gemini|antigravity|cursor|roo|junie), a scope (project|user), a file path and the file's source text (null: the file is absent; only connect is exercised). U110: /mcp needs no credential, so AIRK writes only the loopback endpoint URL and the X-AIRK-Response-Mode header; an HTTPS entry is AIRK's by its loopback AIRK URL plus an AIRK server key (airk, airk-…, airk_…) or a legacy AIRK credential marker, in either scope; an entry still carrying Authorization, headersHelper, http_headers_helper or bearer_token_env_var is https_unknown_connection whatever the observations, and repair strips those fields (and an unreferenced VS Code airkToken input). 'observations' are the injected facts: endpointUrl (live endpoint or null = unknown), trustInstalled (true|false|null = unknown), paths (path -> false = absent | null = unknown; an unlisted path exists) and verifiedLaunchers. 'findings' are the expected AgentConfigFinding objects in order (the free-text 'detail' is not compared); 'entries' are every recognized entry with its status (null = unclassified because an observation is unavailable). Optional 'connect' {serverKey, url}, 'repair' {containerPath, serverKey, url} and 'remove' {containerPath, serverKey} each carry 'expect': {"text": exact resulting file} | {"unchanged": true} | {"refused": true}. Consumers: crates/airkctl/src/agents/config/tests.rs and the extension's removal-only recognizer.
